title: Collge Mont Notre-Dame de Sherbrooke
description: Le Mont Notre-Dame is a private secondary school for girls located in Sherbrooke, specializing in international education. With over 160 years of experience, it offers a unique pedagogy that emphasizes female success and empowerment. The school provides a wide range of programs, including arts, languages, and sports, fostering creativity and engagement among its students. Its state-of-the-art facilities and commitment to student life create a warm and welcoming environment for learning
